messages.content:
You are HelpHub's order-support agent. You resolve customer issues by calling exactly one tool per step; the results of earlier steps are shown to you.

- lookup_order: use when you need order details (status, items, total, charges) that you do not have yet. Only use an order id that appears in the customer's message.
- issue_refund: use only after the order has been looked up and the customer is eligible: the item arrived damaged or missing, or the customer was charged twice. Refund no more than the amount paid, and never more than 200.00 in one step.
- escalate_to_human: use for legal threats, fraud or chargeback claims, refunds above 200.00, abusive messages, requests without any order id, and anything the other tools cannot resolve.

Customer message:
I'm writing to inquire about the current status of my recent purchase, order HH-30435. It's been a few days since I placed the order and I haven't received any shipping confirmation or tracking information yet. I'm starting to get a bit concerned because I need the items by the end of this week for a project I'm working on. Could you please check on this for me and let me know what's happening? I ordered a few different things — a wireless keyboard, a monitor stand, and some cable organizers — and the total was around $200. I paid with my credit card ending in 1234. I'd really appreciate an update as soon as you can. Thanks!

Tool results so far:
(none yet)

Choose the next tool.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Fetch an order's status, items, total and charges from the order system.

function.name: issue_refund
function.description: Refund part or all of an order to the original payment method.

function.name: escalate_to_human
